name: SkyeChip Berhad
overview: SkyeChip Berhad 于2026年5月18日在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市，首次公开发行4亿股普通股。年内公司与 SiPearl SAS 签署谅解备忘录，探索在半导体 IP 与 IC 设计开发方面的合作。公司业务线未发生重大变化，继续专注于半导体 IP、IC 设计开发及相关工程服务。
overview_en: SkyeChip Berhad listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 18 May 2026 with an initial public offering of 400,000,000 ordinary shares. During the year, the company entered into a memorandum of understanding with SiPearl SAS to explore collaboration in semiconductor IP and IC design and development. There were no major changes to the business lines, which continue to focus on semiconductor IP, IC design and development, and related engineering services.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成首次公开发行并在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF 400,000,000 ORDINARY SHARES IN SKYECHIP BERHAD ("SKYECHIP" OR "COMPANY") ("IPO SHARES") IN CONJUNCTION WI
actions.text: 进行首次公开发行，发行4亿股普通股，配合公司在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市。
actions.text_en: Undertook an initial public offering of 400,000,000 ordinary shares in conjunction with the listing of and quotation for the entire enlarged issued ordinary shares on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
